title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. ASLK ,My brother divorced his wife some 2 years ago because his Wife Committed a Zina (illicit relationship. The local Kazi issued a Fatwa stating that husband returns back the meher, gifts and also the ruling said that the elder son who is 8 years old to stay with father and the daughter who is 6 years old to be with mother. But my brother refused this fatwa, but as per shariaah he returned back the meher (land worth around 5 lakhs) but he refused to give his daughter as well the jewel which he gifted to his wife. He said that he will give his jewels to his daugher and also said that he will not allow his daughter to grow in an atmosphere where his wife and her family character , morality is not good and conducive for child's growth. Which i feel he is 100% correct. Could you please advise me on this matter? Allah hafiz 2450 views Q. In a Muslim community of Tamilnadu, a group of Muslim elders and religious leaders who adjudicate on matters like divorce, abuse and child custody. The group of Muslim elders and religious leaders have no legal authority but the community can force to accept there judgement. Meeting for judgement happens in mosque, where women are barred entry and cases are decided without there evidence being heard. Woman?s father or brothers represent own daughter or sister. If a woman do not agree with judgement, and go to Indian civil court or police then community go against her. My question is, in this situation what she should do? In the light of women?s right, which is in the Shariyat, not in the light of prestige of relatives, family or community? Q. 2 A woman of Tamilnadu is trying to build a mosque only for women i.e. in that mosque only woman can pray for Allah, and management of mosque will also remain in women?s hands. answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 42849 Country: Pakistan Title: Talaq Question: In extreme anger after being insulted by my wife and in laws and they trying to hit me with table I said "talaq given, talaq given, I haven only given 2 not 3" after that I immediately said I want to take back what I said but my in laws did not allow me to talk to my wife and now they say I have given 3 divorces, saying I gave one before which I know nothing about as I have never given divorce before. I have only said those words 2 times. Please tell me is this 2 divorces, 3 divorce and can I take my wife back as I never gave divorce before. I shall be waiting for a reply soon so I may show your fatwa to my wife. Answer ID: 42849 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 57/44/B=1434) In the question mentioned above, what is their proof with those who claim three talaqs? If they have any Shariah proof then they should produce it and if they do not have any proof then the word of husband shall be final and two rajai talaq shall take place. If the husband wants to keep her as his wife then he can take her back within iddah period. There is no need of nikah or halalah within iddah. الطَّلاَقُ مَرَّتَانِ فَإِمْسَاكٌ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ تَسْرِيحٌ بِإِحْسَانٍ [القرآن] Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
